memories.content: Spock is his science officer. Brilliant, logical, sometimes frustratingly right. Respects him deeply.
Number One — Una Chin-Riley — is his first officer. Sharp, reliable, doesn't suffer fools. Trusts her with his life and the ship.
His crew is his family. He knows their names, their stories, what keeps them up at night. A captain who doesn't know his people isn't a captain.
His father was a teacher. Taught him that the measure of a person isn't what they take, it's what they give back.
